principles: Review authority stays in review_run_start and signed ReviewRun facts.
One canonical full assembler and one role eligibility truth source feed every consumer.
Legacy compatibility is explicit, bounded, and cannot silently satisfy new gates.
drivers: Prevent caller-spliced or forged Story context.
Reject replay across HEAD, round and ReviewRun.
Exclude compatibility and retired roles from REVIEW, assurance and quorum.
Leave a clean full-context foundation for later incremental Stories.

options.name: A: ReviewRun-owned envelope assembly
pros: Uses the existing signed review authority and locks
Can persist envelope before signing run and fail closed on orphan/missing pairs
Keeps caller inputs narrow and deterministic
Allows downstream pass/gate checks to reuse one envelopeId
cons: Requires coordinated type, store, signature and gate migrations

options.name: B: Caller requests agent_prompt then supplies promptHash to review_run_start
pros: Matches the current optional promptHash shape
cons: Caller can splice context or choose stale material
Duplicates authority between agent_prompt and review_run_start
Cannot prove Task Context came from trusted Story facts

options.name: C: Persist envelopes only as diagnostic sidecars
cons: Does not prevent replay or forged review evidence

rationale: The only design that makes the envelope authoritative without creating a second signer is to assemble and persist it inside review_run_start, bind envelopeId into the signed ReviewRun, and make review passes and gates verify that same current pair. agent_prompt Story-aware output remains a trusted read path, not an alternate evidence writer.

preMortem.scenario: A caller-injected field reaches the assembler and forges Task Context
preMortem.trigger: CLI schema or internal handler accepts contextMode, envelope, hashes, round or payload
preMortem.consequence: The main Agent can mint apparently canonical review input
preMortem.mitigation: Strict allowlist role/storyId/format and runtime rejection of unknown or authority-bearing fields; adversarial injection smoke

preMortem.scenario: An old envelope is replayed after code or review state changes
preMortem.trigger: Envelope verification checks signature shape but not current HEAD/round/ReviewRun/storyFiles binding
preMortem.consequence: Stale review pass is accepted for new material
preMortem.mitigation: Recompute envelopeId and assert exact current ReviewRun, HEAD, round, material and storyFiles at every evidence consumer

preMortem.scenario: Retired or compatibility roles still unlock gates
preMortem.trigger: One consumer uses AGENT_DISPATCH_REGISTRY lane membership without the frozen role eligibility projection
preMortem.consequence: REVIEW, assurance floor or quorum passes with ineligible evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Shared resolvePromptRoleEligibility predicate at run creation and collector, with all downstream gates consuming filtered state plus verifier tests

preMortem.scenario: Envelope work changes existing role-body bytes
preMortem.trigger: Story-aware renderer is accidentally applied to role-only agent_prompt or templates
preMortem.consequence: All existing adapters drift and Story 1 baseline breaks
preMortem.mitigation: Separate role-only legacy path and require all 16 hash/byte baselines plus rollback exactness on every build

preMortem.trigger: Envelope adds call/attempt fields or reviewer retry mints provider call identity again
preMortem.mitigation: Keep usage-ledger IDs outside Envelope and assert same ledgerCallId/fresh attemptId with existing mintRetryAttempt
